publicQuestion: How many lattice paths from (0,0) to (12,12), using unit steps right (1,0) and up (0,1), avoid ALL of the following five points: (3,3), (6,6), (9,9), (4,8), (8,4)? A path "avoids" a point if it never passes through that point. Give just the integer.

judgeNote.validityReason: The problem is self-contained and deterministic. Lattice paths from (0,0) to (12,12) using R and U steps that avoid a given set of points. Computed by both inclusion-exclusion on chain subsets and verified independently by DP on the 13x13 grid, both yielding 573130.
